title: Mitigate cross-tenant RBAC elevation from SAML attribute normalization during KMS rotation — urgent patch
creator: Carlos Mendes
description: Urgent customer escalation: multiple Private clusters observed cross-tenant RBAC elevation following scheduled KMS envelope rotations. SAML assertions from affected IdPs were being attribute-normalized by the auth proxy, resulting in a fallback role mapping that unintentionally granted broader privileges to service principals. Several audit events corresponding to the affected assertions failed to unwrap during rotation, causing gaps in tenant-scoped audit trails. This ticket tracks the emergency patch, tests, and rollout plan.
reproduction_steps:
1) Configure a private cluster with IdP A and KMS envelope rotation enabled.
2) Issue a SAML assertion containing tenant-scoped role attributes plus a custom attribute casing variant (e.g., 'Tenant-Role' vs 'tenantRole').
3) Trigger KMS envelope rotation concurrently with assertion validation.
4) Observe auth-proxy normalization path: attribute mismatch triggers fallback role map (global-admin-like role) and KMS unwrap failure drops audit event.
5) Confirm cross-tenant access by querying a tenant-only endpoint using the affected assertion.
root_cause_analysis: The auth-proxy introduced an attribute-normalization codepath intended to canonicalize incoming SAML attributes (lowercasing keys, trimming whitespace). During KMS envelope rotation we briefly validate signed assertion payloads against an old envelope version; the normalization path runs before tenant-scoped claim validation, which allowed malformed/case-variant attributes to match a fallback role mapping. Simultaneously, the new envelope version produced a secondary unwrap path that returned a transient error (wrapped error suppressed), which the audit pipeline interpreted as 'no event' rather than 'failed unwrap', resulting in missing audit entries. Two orthogonal regressions combined: normalization-before-tenant-guard and suppressed unwrap-errors during rotation.
temporary_mitigation:
1) Roll back the recent auth-proxy normalization change on affected private clusters (hotfix image published).
2) Re-enable strict tenant-claim validation early in the auth flow (feature-flag on).
3) Patch audit pipeline to treat unwrap errors as explicit failures and emit an audit event 'unwrap_failure' with raw metadata.
4) Notified impacted customers (Acme AI and BetaHealth) and provided temporary allowlist-based mitigation for their production traffic.
proposed_fix:
1) Move normalization to after tenant-claim binding and enforce exact-match semantics for tenant and role claims.
2) Harden KMS unwrap handling so envelope-version mismatches result in an auditable failure and safe-reject path rather than message drop.
3) Add strict unit/integration tests for mixed-casing SAML attributes and concurrent KMS rotations.
4) Deploy via canary to two private clusters, monitor RBAC assertions and audit event volume before wider rollout.

rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (Immediate): emergency hotfix rollback already applied to affected clusters.
Phase 1 (Canary): deploy fix to 2 private clusters with high traffic (24h monitoring window). Feature flag 'saml_strict_bind' false by default.
Phase 2 (Staged): enable on additional 8 clusters over 48h if no regressions.
Phase 3 (Global): flip feature flag on for all private clusters and schedule a controlled upgrade for Dedicated.
Rollback criteria: any increase in authentication latency >20ms p95, new auth failures >0.1% or missing audit events.
Monitoring: auth-assertions-per-tenant dashboard, unwrap_failure gauge, RBAC-deny-rate.
acceptance_criteria: All SAML assertions with case-variant attributes bind only to tenant-scoped roles (no fallback broad roles)
KMS unwrap errors produce audit events and do not cause silent audit drops
No regression in auth latency (p95 within 10ms of baseline) across canary clusters
Automated tests added and passing in CI: unit + integration covering rotation race
qa_plan:

postmortem_action_items: Make tenant-claim exact-match first-class invariant in auth-proxy (ENG-AP-2026)
Add unwrap_failure to standard audit schema and dashboarding (observability team)
Run a one-time audit backfill for dropped events during 2026-03-10 rotation window
Add chaos tests for KMS envelope rotation race conditions in CI
